description: This file defines the RenderContentAsText class, a FreeMarker TemplateTransformModel implementation for rendering content as text within the Apache OFBiz framework. It processes content rendering, manages context state, and generates HTML or text output for content fragments, including optional editing interfaces.

classes.name: RenderContentAsText
classes.description: A FreeMarker TemplateTransformModel to render content as text within OFBiz, managing rendering context, optional editing controls, and content encoding.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Initializes the transformation, manages context, and returns a custom Writer to handle content rendering and output.

methods.name: renderSubContent
methods.description: Performs actual content rendering based on context, encoding, and optional editing UI elements.

methods.name: openEditWrap
methods.description: Outputs the HTML opening tags for the editing interface.

methods.name: closeEditWrap
methods.description: Outputs the HTML closing tags and an edit link for content editing.

methods.name: getEditStyle
methods.description: Determines the CSS class style used for the editing interface, defaulting from properties if not specified.
